content.comment_body: I want to use the electric doorbell signal as a sensor input and have the door open automatically when the doorbell is pressed. The signal should be 12V, interrupted at approximately 1 kHz by the doorbell buzzer. Can this type of signal be detected by [product_name] (AC)?

No, this isn't possible with a 230V version of [product_name]. For your scenario, you need a [product_name] that supports 12/24V. Only these variants can properly read 12V signals. Inputs I5 and I6 on these models can handle up to 2000 pulses per second, while the 230V version is limited to 5 pulses per second.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is examining whether [product_name] (AC) can detect a rapid 12V pulsed signal from a doorbell to enable automatic door opening. Responses highlight an important limitation: this model cannot process 12V signals at high frequency, and only specific variants with 12/24V capability are compatible and have the necessary input response.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] (AC) to reliably recognize a 12V, 1 kHz interrupted signal for automation as a sensor input.
